def main():
    mod = 10**9 + 7
    p, k = map(int, input().split())

    ans = 1
    if k == 0:
        for _ in range(p - 1):
            ans = (ans * p) % mod
    else:
        cc = p

        class DS:
            def __init__(self, n):
                self.parent = list(range(n))
                self.cont = [1] * n
                self.cc = 0

            def SetOf(self, x):
                if self.parent[x] != x:
                    self.parent[x] = self.SetOf(self.parent[x])
                return self.parent[x]

            def Merge(self, x, y):
                x = self.SetOf(x)
                y = self.SetOf(y)
                if x == y:
                    return False
                if self.cont[x] > self.cont[y]:
                    x, y = y, x
                self.cc += int(self.cont[x] == 1 and self.cont[y] == 1)
                self.cc -= int(self.cont[x] > 1 and self.cont[y] > 1)
                self.parent[x] = y
                self.cont[y] += self.cont[x]
                return True

        ds = DS(p)
        for i in range(p):
            cc -= ds.Merge(i, (k * i) % p)

        if k > 1:
            cc = ds.cc
        for _ in range(cc):
            ans = (ans * p) % mod

    print(ans)

main()
